arxiv-2205-06873.title: Using Augmented Face Images to Improve Facial Recognition Tasks Conference: ; ;
arxiv-2205-06873.creator: Shuo Cheng, Guoxian Song, Wan-Chun Ma, Chao Wang, Linjie Luo
arxiv-2205-06873.description:
A 2022 arXiv research paper by Shuo Cheng, Guoxian Song, Wan-Chun Ma, Chao Wang, Linjie Luo. We present a framework that uses GAN-augmented images to complement certain specific attributes, usually underrepresented, for machine learning model training. This allows us to improve inference quality over those attributes for the facial recognition tasks. Introduction

The process of training a machine learning (ML) model is primarily about tuning its parameters such that it can map any input to a specific output.

arxiv-2212-11774.title: A literature review on different types of empirically evaluated bug localization approaches
arxiv-2212-11774.creator: F.H. Zamfirov
arxiv-2212-11774.description: Abstract I Introduction Today, software systems have a significant role in various domains among which are healthcare, entertainment, transport and logistics, and many more. It is only natural that with this increasing dependency on software, the number of software systems increases. Additionally, these systems become more and more complex.

arxiv-2307-06962.title: Copy is All You Need
arxiv-2307-06962.creator: Tian Lan, Deng Cai, Yan Wang, Heyan Huang, Xian-Ling Mao
arxiv-2307-06962.description: Abstract The dominant text generation models compose the output by sequentially selecting words from a fixed vocabulary. In this paper, we formulate text generation as progressively copying text segments (e.g., words or phrases) from an existing text collection. We compute the contextualized representations of meaningful text segments and index them using efficient vector search toolkits.

arxiv-2310-05813.title: Audio compression-assisted feature extraction for voice replay attack detection
arxiv-2310-05813.creator: Xiangyu Shi, Yuhao Luo, Li Wang, Haorui He, Hao Li, Lei Wang, Zhizheng Wu
arxiv-2310-05813.description: Abstract Replay attack is one of the most effective and simplest voice spoofing attacks. Detecting replay attacks is challenging, according to the Automatic Speaker Verification Spoofing and Countermeasures Challenge 2021 (ASVspoof 2021), because they involve a loudspeaker, a microphone, and acoustic conditions (e.g., background noise).

arxiv-2405-14407.title: Dynamic Graph Unlearning: A General and Efficient Post-Processing Method via Gradient Transformation
arxiv-2405-14407.creator: He Zhang, Bang Wu, Xiangwen Yang, Xingliang Yuan, Xiaoning Liu, Xun Yi
arxiv-2405-14407.description: Abstract . Dynamic graph neural networks (DGNNs) have emerged and been widely deployed in various web applications (e.g., Reddit) to serve users (e.g., personalized content delivery) due to their remarkable ability to learn from complex and dynamic user interaction data. Despite benefiting from high-quality services, users have raised privacy concerns, such as misuse of personal data (e.g.

arxiv-2506-20741.title: OTSurv: A Novel Multiple Instance Learning Framework for Survival Prediction with Heterogeneity-aware Optimal Transport
arxiv-2506-20741.creator: Qin Ren 1 Yifan Wang 1 Ruogu Fang 3 Haibin Ling 1 Chenyu You 1,2
arxiv-2506-20741.description: Abstract Survival prediction using whole slide images (WSIs) can be formulated as a multiple instance learning (MIL) problem. However, existing MIL methods often fail to explicitly capture pathological heterogeneity within WSIs, both globally – through long-tailed morphological distributions, and locally – through tile-level prediction uncertainty.

arxiv-2508-10559.title: Fake Speech Wild: Detecting Deepfake Speech on Social Media Platform
arxiv-2508-10559.creator: Yuankun Xie, Ruibo Fu, Xiaopeng Wang, Zhiyong Wang, Ya Li, Zhengqi Wen, Haonnan Cheng, Long Ye
arxiv-2508-10559.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yuankun Xie, Ruibo Fu, Xiaopeng Wang, Zhiyong Wang, Ya Li, Zhengqi Wen, Haonnan Cheng, Long Ye. The rapid advancement of speech generation technology has led to the widespread proliferation of deepfake speech across social media platforms. While deepfake audio countermeasures (CMs) achieve promising results on public datasets, their performance degrades significantly in cross-domain scenarios.

arxiv-2512-13825.title: Unreasonable effectiveness of unsupervised learning in identifying Majorana topology
arxiv-2512-13825.creator: Jacob Taylor, Haining Pan, Sankar Das Sarma
arxiv-2512-13825.description: Abstract In unsupervised learning, the training data for deep learning does not come with any labels, thus forcing the algorithm to discover hidden patterns in the data for discerning useful information. This, in principle, could be a powerful tool in identifying topological order since topology does not always manifest in obvious physical ways (e.g., topological superconductivity) for its decisive confirmation.

Previously, we have shown the loss of anti-Bax function in Creutzfeldt Jakob disease (CJD)-associated prion protein (PrP) mutants that are unable to generate cytosolic PrP (CyPrP). pmc-10735680.title: NURSING HOME SOCIAL WORK: CONFLICTING VALUES AND ETHICAL PRACTICE WITH RESIDENTS, FAMILIES, AND STAFF
pmc-10735680.creator: Mercedes Bern-Klug, Denise Gammonley
pmc-10735680.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). People who live in nursing homes and those who spend weeks or months there recuperating from a hip replacement or stroke have a broad range of needs, many urgent and others enduring. Despite the high needs of residents—which have increased over the past decade as resident acuity has increased-- the settings are typically under-staffed both in terms of the number of direct care staff and the preparation of direct care staff (NASEM Report, 2022).

pmc-11293075.title: The preventive and carcinogenic effect of metals on cancer: a systematic review
pmc-11293075.creator: Amir Hossein Khoshakhlagh, Mahdiyeh Mohammadzadeh, Agnieszka Gruszecka-Kosowska
pmc-11293075.description: BackgroundMany studies have investigated the role of metals in various types of malignancies. Considering the wide range of studies conducted in this field and the achievement of different results, the presented systematic review was performed to obtain the results of investigations on the prevention and occurrence of various types of cancer associated with metal exposures.

pmc-11454542.title: 6376 Wnt/beta-catenin Pathway is Associated with Cell Proliferation in Growth Hormone-producing Pituitary Tumors
pmc-11454542.creator: Saki Kuwabara, Hiraku Kameda, Hiroshi Nomoto, Kyu Yong Cho, Akinobu Nakamura, Yukitomo Ishi, Hiroaki Motegi, Miki Fujimura, Tatsuya Atsumi

pmc-11525268.title: Behavioural stochastic resonance across the lifespan
pmc-11525268.creator: Michele Di Ponzio, Luca Battaglini, Marco Bertamini, Giulio Contemori
pmc-11525268.description: Stochastic resonance (SR) is the phenomenon wherein the introduction of a suitable level of noise enhances the detection of subthreshold signals in non linear systems. It manifests across various physical and biological systems, including the human brain. Psychophysical experiments have confirmed the behavioural impact of stochastic resonance on auditory, somatic, and visual perception.

pmc-11561000.title: Importance and variability of the paternal component in sow reproductive traits
pmc-11561000.creator: G Cieleń, E Sell-Kubiak
pmc-11561000.description: Reproductive traits are an integral part of the goals of the breeding programs that contribute to the economic success of production. Reproductive phenotypes such as litter size, number of piglets born alive, or litter weight at birth are mainly attributed to females. Thus, the maternal components can be found by default in quantitative genetics’ animal models.

pmc-11692762.title: SAFETY AND EFFECTS OF HEAT-INACTIVATED LACTOBACILLUS PARACASEI D3.5 (LPD3.5) ON MENTAL WELLBEING IN OLDER ADULTS
pmc-11692762.creator: Amanda Lloyd, Alina Warren-Walker, Nigel Holt, Doug Lynch, Denis Kay, Kevin Stephens, Shalini Jain, Hariom Yadav
pmc-11692762.description: A healthy gastrointestinal (GI) tract and its microbiome are crucial for maintaining overall health, while microbiome abnormalities can lead to various health issues including brain health and impact quality of life (QOL). These issues are often linked to dysregulation of the gut-brain axis. Although probiotics and prebiotics are common strategies to improve gut and brain health, they have limitations.

pmc-12017104.title: Incidence Trends of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus, Medication-Induced Diabetes, and Monogenic Diabetes in Canadian Children, Then (2006–2008) and Now (2017–2019)
pmc-12017104.creator: Trisha J. Patel, Aysha Ayub, Jeffrey N. Bone, Stasia Hadjiyannakis, Mélanie Henderson, Munier A. Nour, Teresa E. Pinto, Brandy Wicklow, Jill K. Hamilton, Elizabeth A. C. Sellers, Shazhan Amed
pmc-12017104.description: Introduction The landscape of childhood diabetes has evolved and addressing the knowledge gaps in non-Type 1 diabetes mellitus are key to accurate diagnosis. Objectives A national surveillance study was completed between 2006 and 2008 and then repeated between 2017 and 2019 to describe Canadian incidence trends and clinical characteristics of non-Type 1 diabetes mellitus.

pmc-12411599.title: Splenomegaly, Spleen Amyloidosis and Neutrophil Infiltration are Present in 3xTg-AD, but not Tg-SwDI Mice
pmc-12411599.creator: Gonzalo Acero, Adrian Rodriguez-Lopez, Georgina Díaz, Daniel Esteban, Mónica Herrera-Ángeles, Goar Gevorkian
pmc-12411599.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). It is now widely accepted that the development of neurodegenerative diseases depends on and affects many pathological processes, both in the brain and the periphery. Inflammatory, cardiovascular, metabolic, cerebrovascular, autoimmune, and other environmental factors have been extensively studied and shown to contribute notably to the onset, pathogenesis, and clinical outcome of Alzheimer´s disease (AD), Parkinson´s disease (PD), cerebral amyloid angiopathy (CAA), multiple sclerosis, and other neurological disorders.

pmc-12568930.title: RETRACTED ARTICLE: Novel design of a dual-band microstrip antenna array for 6G mmWave applications
pmc-12568930.creator: Amin Al Ka’bi
pmc-12568930.description: This paper proposes an innovative microstrip antenna design, which can offer dual-band and dual-circular polarization capability, dedicated to small autonomous aerial vehicles (AAVs)/low Earth orbit (LEO) satellites operation at the K/Ka-band. The design uses arrow-shaped (left) and T-shaped (right) stubs to achieve right-hand and left-hand circular polarization in two frequency bands.

pmc-13261850.title: Identification of disease-specific regulatory networks in prurigo nodularis versus atopic dermatitis through ATAC/RNA single-nucleus profiling
pmc-13261850.creator: Yuntian Wu, Rachael Bogle, Matthew T Patrick, Gharaee-Kermani Mehrnaz, Xianying Xing, Allison C Billi, J Michelle Kahlenberg, Valérie Julia, Johann E Gudjonsson, Lam C Tsoi
pmc-13261850.description: Background:Prurigo nodularis (PN) is a chronic neuroimmune skin disorder characterized by chronic itch and multiple pruriginous nodules, and is related to atopic dermatitis (AD). While different transcriptomic studies have been conducted, the regulatory mechanisms and differences between PN and AD remain poorly understood.Objective:We aimed to uncover shared and distinct regulatory mechanisms between PN and AD.

pmc-13374129.title: Potentially functional variants of CYP2A6 and ABHD12 in the arachidonic acid metabolism pathway genes predict the survival of HBV-related hepatocellular carcinoma patients
pmc-13374129.creator: Junzheng Peng, Qiuling Lin, Zihan Zhou, Qiuping Wen, Qiuyan Mo, Yanji Jiang, Peiqin Chen, Yingchun Liu, Hongping Yu, Xiaoxia Wei
pmc-13374129.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Arachidonic acid (AA) metabolism plays essential roles in inflammation, tissue regeneration, immune regulation, and tumorigenesis. However, the prognostic significance of genetic variants in AA metabolism genes for hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) remains unclear. We analyzed 56 AA metabolism-related genes in 866 HBV-HCC patients using Cox proportional hazards regression, with Bayesian false discovery probability and false positive report probability for multiple testing correction.

pmc-13557810.title: Disaster Management in Hemodialysis Centers: Ensuring Continuity of Lifesaving Care
pmc-13557810.creator: Muhammad N. Hashmi, Saad Almarzouk, Fayez Hejaili, Hammad Raza
pmc-13557810.description: Hemodialysis is a life-sustaining therapy that depends on uninterrupted access to electricity, clean water, medical supplies, and trained staff. This dependence makes hemodialysis units uniquely vulnerable to disasters such as natural catastrophes, power failures, pandemics, or civil emergencies. The COVID-19 pandemic, major earthquakes, and large-scale floods have highlighted the fragility of dialysis infrastructure worldwide.

pmc-13609041.title: A Large-Aperture Variable Iris Directly Driven by a V-Shaped Mode-Coupled Ultrasonic Motor: Design, Optimization, and Experimental Validation
pmc-13609041.creator: Benchao Lv, Jun Zhao, Hongsheng Sun, Xucong Bao, Tong Zhao, Xiaolin Wang, Zhiyuan Yao, Xinjian Li, Xiaoniu Li
pmc-13609041.description: Large-aperture variable irises must provide continuous aperture regulation within a restricted axial space. This study presents a laboratory prototype of a 20-blade iris directly driven by a V-shaped mode-coupled ultrasonic motor. The iris was geometrically designed for a 5.5 mm–98 mm clear-aperture range. A wave-spring–bearing compliant preload mechanism was designed to maintain blade compression while permitting low-resistance actuating-ring rotation.

pmc-13657374.title: Massively parallel functional profiling prioritizes breast cancer risk variants and implicates CCDC88C in ER-positive breast cancer
pmc-13657374.creator: Kate Mackie, Harriet Kemp, Andrea Gunnell, James B. Studd, Molly Went, Philip Law, Katarzyna Tomczyk, Rafaela Ferreira, Ernesto Lopez, Selin Sevgi, Yunjiao Lu, Alisa Zvereva, Nick Orr, Richard S. Houlston, Nichola Johnson, Olivia Fletcher, Syed Haider
pmc-13657374.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). SummaryGenome-wide association studies (GWASs), combined with fine-mapping, have identified 196 independent signals associated with breast cancer risk. Deciphering the functional basis of these associations can inform our understanding of the biology and etiology of breast cancer. Decoding GWAS risk associations is challenging due to linkage disequilibrium between variants and because most variants map to non-coding regions, influencing breast cancer risk via cis-regulatory mechanisms that modulate the expression of target genes.

stendhal-charterhouse-parma-moncrieff-19.title: The Charterhouse of Parma
stendhal-charterhouse-parma-moncrieff-19.creator: Stendhal, trans. C. K. Scott Moncrieff
stendhal-charterhouse-parma-moncrieff-19.description: La Chartreuse de Parme — Stendhal's Napoleonic masterpiece: Fabrice del Dongo, the Battle of Waterloo, and court intrigue at Parma; Balzac called it the century's greatest novel. Scott Moncrieff's translation, complete in two volumes, with Balzac's 'Study of M. Beyle' and Stendhal's reply.
